subject: Tick PRs after the #1480 landing: #1471 merged, #1476 conflicted, #1479 red at the midnight gate
body: The routines gate that refused your lane-deliver from 2026-10-09T00:00Z is cleared on mainline (#1480 merged e276446d at 02:43Z).
